relations.text: 2026年1月、ウェルズ・ファーゴの貨車リース事業(約10万1千両)を合弁経由で42億ドルで取得
relations.text_en: Closed the purchase of Wells Fargo's rail operating lease portfolio (about 101,000 railcars) through a joint venture in January 2026

source.label: GATX 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 1, 2026, we closed on the acquisition of Wells Fargo's rail operating lease portfolio.

companies.name: ブルックフィールド・インフラストラクチャー

relations.text: GATXと組んだ合弁を通じて、ウェルズ・ファーゴの貨車約10万1千両を取得
relations.text_en: Bought about 101,000 railcars from Wells Fargo through a joint venture with GATX

source.label: GATX 8-K/A(2026年3月、鉄道車両の取得)
source.quote: acquired approximately 101,000 railcars from Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., a national banking association, and its affiliates ("Wells Fargo"), for $4.2 billion through a newly formed joint venture with Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and its institutional partners

companies.name: オーバーランド・アドバンテージ
companies.sub: 中堅企業向け融資ファンド

relations.text: ウェルズ・ファーゴの中堅企業の取引先から投資案件の紹介を受ける契約を持つ
relations.text_en: Has a sourcing arrangement that gives it access to deals from Wells Fargo's middle-market corporate clients

source.label: Overland Advantage 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The Advisor believes that the Wells Fargo Sourcing Arrangement provides a competitive advantage to the Advisor and access for the Company to potential investment opportunities originating from Wells Fargo's middle market corporate clients.

relations.text: 買収資金の一部として、ウェルズ・ファーゴが最大9億ドルのつなぎ融資を約束
relations.text_en: Wells Fargo committed up to $900 million of bridge financing for part of an acquisition

source.label: SiTime 10-Q(2026年第1四半期)
source.quote: pursuant to which Wells Fargo has committed to provide us with debt financing to fund a portion of the Cash Consideration in an aggregate principal amount of up to $ 900.0 million

relations.text: ウェルズ・ファーゴとの回転信用枠を持つ
relations.text_en: Has a revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo

source.label: Boot Barn 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Failure to comply with any of these covenants could result in a default under the Wells Fargo Revolver and under other agreements containing cross-default provisions.

companies.name: アズベリー・オートモーティブ

relations.text: 2025年7月、ウェルズ・ファーゴの不動産担保融資で5.465億ドルを借り入れ
relations.text_en: Borrowed $546.5 million under a Wells Fargo real estate term loan in July 2025

source.label: Asbury Automotive 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: 2025 Wells Fargo Real Estate Facility -On July 21, 2025, certain subsidiaries of the Company borrowed $546.5 million

companies.name: レンジャー・エナジー・サービシズ

relations.text: ウェルズ・ファーゴと最大7,500万ドルの担保付き信用枠の契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Has a secured credit facility of up to $75 million with Wells Fargo

source.label: Ranger Energy Services 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On May 31, 2023, we entered into a Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., which provides a secured, revolving credit facility

relations.text: Synchronyが10-Kで、提携先獲得の主な競合としてウェルズ・ファーゴを挙げる
relations.text_en: Synchrony names Wells Fargo among its primary competitors for partners

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors for partners include major financial institutions such as American Express, Bread Financial, Capital One/Discover, JPMorgan Chase, Citibank, TD Bank and Wells Fargo

relations.text: UBSが年次報告で、米州で強い主な競合の一社としてウェルズ・ファーゴを挙げる
relations.text_en: UBS names Wells Fargo among its main competitors with a strong position in the Americas

source.label: UBS 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: competitors with a strong position in the Americas but with more limited global footprints, such as Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo
